title.description: A short topic title that names the unit's idea or finding, not a breadcrumb of the paper's own headings.

outline_first.description: Index of the first outline entry in this unit.

outline_last.description: Index of the last outline entry in this unit; equal to outline_first for a one-entry unit.

summary.description: One or two sentences that synthesize the whole unit.

question.description: One line: the question this unit answers for the reader, which is why its parts belong together.

sections.description: Coherent reading units, usually 2-3 pages of content each, as contiguous ranges of the given outline entries in order, without gaps or overlaps. Never one unit per heading.

description: The paper's reading map as ranges of its outline.
